claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether a correction magnitude that improves two opened interactions transfers to a third untouched interaction of the same physical object. It compares the frozen maximin scale with both the released checkpoint and the globally validated 0.125 correction. The six-object cohort differs from the published validation split, so the published 6.498 mm value is contextual rather than a table-SOTA gate.
